violated_contract: A required account-wipe step must be able to succeed on a later retry. A provider request that always exceeds a provider limit, or a completion fence that only an operator can clear, makes the queue retry the wipe forever while the deleted account's data stays in place.
canonical_prevention: Bound provider requests at the shared owner adapter (database.pinecone_partition_index) by the provider's measured limit, and make purge verification wait only for outstanding work that could still write owner data. Unrelated fences such as migration reconciliation must not gate erasure.
